en:
You showed me a great time today...
Just what I'd expect from my sidekick!

Let's hang out next time too! I can't 
have my sidekick picking someone else!
We should probably get back now.
When I'm with you, time just flies by.

I'll never get bored of hanging out 
with you, man. Let's do it again soon!
Let's head back to the dorms.

If you're not feeling well, just rest. 
My sidekick's fatigue is my fatigue.

C'mon, man. Don't go forgetting a 
sidekick's responsibilities.
